pages.pricing.disabled.heading: This install cannot take payments
pages.pricing.tax.heading: Tax and refunds
pages.billing.subtitle: {account} — what you are using, what you are paying, and what happens next.
pages.billing.usage.heading: Usage this month
pages.billing.usage.note: Billable means pageviews plus custom events, across every site on this account, for the calendar month in UTC. Engagement pings and pageview goals are not counted — they would be charging you twice for something you already sent.
pages.billing.history.heading: The last few months
pages.billing.plan.heading: Your plan
pages.billing.plan.comped_detail: This account does not need a card and will not be charged.
pages.billing.plan.no_card: No card on file. Nothing has been charged and no customer record exists with our payment provider.
pages.billing.upgrade.label: Upgrade
pages.billing.comped.heading: Complimentary account
pages.billing.comped.detail: Your account is fully active. Analytics, collection, exports, and settings remain available without a subscription.
pages.billing.next.heading: What happens next
pages.billing.data.heading: Your data
pages.billing.data.body: Export works in every phase of an account's life, including the day before deletion. It is your data and portability is not conditional on payment.
pages.billing.growing.heading: Growing past a million
pages.billing.growing.body: You are close to, or past, the volume included in the plan. Nothing breaks and nothing is deleted — but there is usually a better arrangement at this size.
pages.billing.growing.subject: Enterprise volume for {account}
pages.banner.trial.heading: Your trial ends on {locks}
pages.banner.trial.detail: Everything works normally until then. After that the dashboard locks, but we keep collecting your data until {stops} — so upgrading before that date leaves no gap in your history.
pages.banner.card.heading: We could not charge your card
pages.banner.card.detail: Nothing has changed yet. Your dashboard locks on {locks}, and we keep collecting until {stops}. Updating your card fixes it immediately.
pages.banner.locked.heading: Your dashboard is locked — and we are still collecting
pages.banner.locked.detail: Nothing is lost. Every event from your sites is still being recorded, and it all comes back the moment you pay. We stop collecting on {stops}; on {deletes} live data is removed. Storage and recovery systems outside the application follow their operators' retention controls, and provider deletion retries hourly.
pages.banner.dormant.heading: We have stopped collecting
pages.banner.dormant.detail: Everything already recorded is safe until {deletes}, and you can export all of it right now. The days since {stops} will show on your graphs as a labelled gap rather than as zeroes.
pages.banner.deleted.heading: This account is scheduled for deletion
pages.banner.deleted.detail: On {deletes}, the hourly sweep removes live account data immediately. Storage and recovery systems outside the application follow their operators' retention controls. Payment-provider deletion is retried hourly until it succeeds. Export below before then.
pages.timeline.locked: The dashboard locks. We keep collecting everything.
pages.timeline.dormant: We stop collecting. A labelled gap starts on your graphs.
pages.timeline.deleted: Live data is removed immediately. Storage and recovery systems outside the application follow their operators' retention controls, and provider deletion retries hourly until complete.
pages.checkout.disabled.body: No payment provider is configured here. That is the normal state of a self-hosted install, and nothing about the software you are running is limited by it.
pages.portal.disabled.body: No payment provider is configured here, so there is no billing portal to open.
pages.portal.missing.heading: No billing portal yet
pages.portal.missing.body: A portal exists once an account has been through checkout at least once.
pages.export.heading: Download everything we hold
pages.export.contents: An export is a ZIP of the ten roll-up tables plus every raw event, one row each, in a format you can load somewhere else.
pages.export.always: It works in every state an account can be in — including a locked dashboard, a stopped collection, and the day before a scheduled deletion. It is your data, and portability is not something we switch off for non-payment.
pages.export.not_yet: Prepare one at /settings/<your domain>/imports. The download link is good for 24 hours, and preparing another takes seconds.
